h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Morena

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Morena

items.pText: Morena lies in the Chambal region of northern Madhya Pradesh, close to the Rajasthan border, and its summers are among the hottest in central India. For a school or park here, the real question is how to make a playground usable in May and June. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 950 km away, and sends it by road.

We supply schools, colonies, municipal parks and private institutions. Send us the size of the site, the age group and a few photos that show where the sun falls during the day. We will suggest equipment and shade, and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked before you approve a quote for your site.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Adding shade to a hot playground

c: In a Chambal summer, unshaded slides and decks become too hot to touch by late morning. Shade is the most useful addition you can make. A
from our garden decor range can sit beside the play area as a waiting spot for parents and a cool place for children between turns.

Place toddler equipment in the shadiest part of the site, since small children sit and crawl on surfaces more than older ones. Mature trees help, but keep equipment clear of overhanging branches. items.q: How can we keep a playground usable in Morena's summer?
items.a: Add shade beside or over the play area, put toddler pieces in the shadiest spot and use rubber flooring, which stays cooler than concrete. Morning and evening play times also help.

items.q: Do you supply gazebos and pergolas as well?
items.a: Yes. Our CoreCraft garden decor range includes benches, gazebos and pergolas that can be planned into the same layout drawing as the play equipment.

items.q: Can you deliver to the Chambal region?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer in central India.
